reason: E3 demonstrates reactive wear protection in a different alloy (TiNbZrAg), supporting the general concept of in-situ oxide nanocomposite formation for wear resistance, but none of the cited evidence addresses CoCrFeNi, nanohierarchical microstructures, or the specific claims about oxide glaze behavior across the full temperature range. E1 and E2 provide only test methods and general friction behavior, not support for the key premises.
premises: Nanohierarchical microstructure in CoCrFeNi enhances oxide precipitation during sliding
In-situ formed oxide glaze layer acts as a stable, self-lubricating film reducing friction and wear
